_comment: Shipped defaults for the AHK GUI bridge (ops/loop/claude_gui_bridge.ahk). launch_loop.ps1 copies this to control/ahk_timings.json when that live copy is absent; control/ is runtime state, so an operator edit there survives a relaunch. The bridge re-reads the live copy at EVERY gemini.ready pickup, so a running loop can be retuned without restarting the bridge or the controller. Every key below also has a hardcoded fallback in the script: a missing, truncated or malformed file degrades to these exact values rather than breaking the hands of the loop. These values reproduce the pre-hardening timing behavior exactly.
_units: all *_ms are milliseconds, *_sec is seconds, retries is a count
